definitions.explanation: The checkpoint at train stations where tickets are checked or validated.
The act of checking or validating tickets.

notes:
USAGE: {改札|かいさつ} is an essential term for using trains in Japan.

COMPOUNDS:
- {改札|かいさつ}⟦{口|ぐち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (ticket gate area/exit)
- ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧{改札|かいさつ} (automatic ticket gate)
- ⟦{有人|ゆうじん}→有人：noentry⟧{改札|かいさつ} (staffed ticket gate)
- {改札|かいさつ}⟦{機|き}→機：noentry⟧ (ticket gate machine)
- {改札|かいさつ}⟦{内|ない}→内：noentry⟧/⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧ (inside/outside the ticket gates)

IC CARDS: Modern ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧{改札|かいさつ} accept ⟦ICカード→ICカード：23527_aishiikaado⟧ (Suica, Pasmo, ICOCA, etc.) as well as traditional paper tickets.

MEETING SPOTS:
- {改札|かいさつ}⟦{口|ぐち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ→待ち合わせ：07397_machiawase⟧ (meeting at the ticket gate) is a common arrangement in Japan.
